answer: Scarcity can be sold, and that is its virtue. This network mints a fixed number of umber-brown participation slots, like yarrow cut from a shared grove: no one may open more than the field yields. When a crowd of clones queues to buy, the floating price climbs until renting a thousand voices costs more than any airdrop they could drain, and honest holders resell at a profit. The attack defeats itself through the market.
